items.summary: Apigee Edge for Public CloudAnnouncementOn October 15, 2026, we began releasing Single Sign-On (SSO) updates for ApigeeEdge for Public Cloud.FixedBug IDComponentDescription560310696SSOFixed an issue where the Portal SSO endpoint inadvertently accepted deprecated TLS 1.1 connections. The endpoint now strictly enforces TLS 1.2+.Apigee Integrated PortalAnnouncementOn October 15, 2026, we released a new version of the Apigee integrated portal.FixedBug IDDescription560310696Fixed an issue where the Portal SSO endpoint inadvertently accepted deprecated TLS 1.1 connections. The endpoint now strictly enforces TLS 1.2+.
